g.text: SYSTEMS ARCHAEOLOGY // HARDWARE INTERLOCK STUDIES // PIECE 10
40×40mm MOSAIK MIMIC PANEL & THE ROTTE COLLAR • DEUTSCHE BUNDESBAHN SpDrS60
bool is_blocked = true; // 1 bit in DRAM
• DRAM Bit Flips / Power Loss: Vanishes on brownout.
• Race Conditions: Stale L3 cache line reads false.
• UI Rendering Lag: DOM drops frame during dispatch.
• Software Overrides: Null pointer or typo bypasses check.
• Silent Recovery: Error handler falls back silently.
Safety exists only as long as every abstraction compiles and cooperates.
• Matter Occupies Space: Thumb physically cannot depress.
• Zero Electric Dependency: Collar blocks with zero power.
• Irreversible Audit: Mechanical ratchet: ΔZ ≥ 0 strictly.
• Zwei-Tasten Principle: Dual simultaneous entry required.
• Haptic Feedback: Heavy 3N spring detent confirms state.
Physics does not interpret code. Matter cannot forget its own shape.
